description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Six isopluvial layers provide 24-hour precipitation in inches for 6-month and 2-, 10-, 25-, 50- and 100-year recurrence intervals. Regional frequency analysis with L-moments uses input datasets spanning 1940–2024; the provider explicitly names stormwater and water-quality treatment design. The native layers expose polyline geometry and named attributes, including precip_inches. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for structural design studies. These are statistical design estimates, not observed storms or forecasts. The six recurrence layers are one related design-rainfall resource, not six new independent datasets. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
